record.title: Evaluate reversible sampled AC output sensitivity
record.intent: Apply frozen whole-record AC RMS criteria and identify the next unresolved physical comparison.
requirements: Independently reduce only sealed original records using unwindowed demeaned population AC RMS. Retain every slot, DC/extrema/Vpp/default receive outcome, group means/population SD and uncorrected OFF anchors.

Apply the frozen all-pairs6dB and mean-return0.3dB criteria; preserve zero/low-signal as labeled outcomes without invented finite attenuation or noise fitting. Report positive, negative or inconclusive evidence without changing criteria.

Keep the conclusion at setting-associated sampled complete-chain sensitivity; preserve source transient/load/digital/alias uncertainty and the separate calibrated-bandwidth and matched-software-policy gates. Record the exact next bench question without executing a policy transition in this window.
Commit/push the conclusion and leave clean preserved state before the three-hour deadline.
acceptance: A reproducible sensitivity conclusion or exact inconclusive boundary follows from the sealed control and unchanged frozen criteria.
